description: Flutter and Dart package that generates ZPL label code for Zebra printers: text, barcodes, QR codes, images, TTF fonts, grid layouts, templates, and live preview.
rules: Build a label with ZplGenerator(config: ZplConfiguration(...), commands: [...]) and call `await generator.build()` to get the ZPL string (^XA ... ^XZ).
All coordinates and sizes are printer dots. At 203 dpi (8 dots/mm) a 4x6 inch label is printWidth: 812, labelLength: 1218; a 2x1 inch label is 406 x 203.
Prefer layout widgets (ZplGridRow + ZplGridCol 12-unit grid, ZplColumn, ZplTable) over hand-computed x/y offsets.
For images on Link-OS mobile printers (ZQ series) use ZplImageDownload (~DG) + ZplImageRecall (^XG), not ZplImageInline. Tilde commands are emitted before ^XA automatically.

Keep image compression at ZplImageCompression.none (the default) unless the printer firmware supports B64/Z64. Threshold dithering avoids dense output that can trip mobile print-head thermal protection.
For many labels with one layout use ZplTemplate(generator): call `await template.init()` once, then template.bindSync({'name': value}) per label to fill {{name}} placeholders.
Custom fonts: `final font = await ZplFontUpload.fromAsset('assets/font.ttf', 'A')`, add it to commands, and pass it as ZplText(customFont: font).
ZplNativePreview renders offline on a Flutter canvas; ZplPreview and LabelaryService use the Labelary web API and need network access.
This package only generates ZPL. To print, use flutter_zpl_printer (0.2.0+), which re-exports this package: `await printer.printLabel(generator)` or `printer.printZpl(zpl)`.
